description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange, effective from 28.09.2020 to 04.10.2020
categorisation: This gazette notification is issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) and establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and charges. It constitutes a regulatory framework for customs operations, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette. While it names the Director General of Customs, this is in his official capacity to issue the regulatory notice, not a personnel appointment or change. The content focuses entirely on establishing legal rates and rescinding previous regulations, not on government structure or personnel matters.
